rows.label: PPP conversion factor (2017 international $ per US $)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: PPP conversion factor, household final consumption (PA.NUS.PRVT.PP) and official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF)
source.note: Congo, Dem. Rep., 2017: 634.3036 Congolese francs per international $ (household consumption PPP) and 1,464.4179 francs per US$ (PA.NUS.FCRF); 1,464.4179 / 634.3036 = 2.3087 (WDI last updated 2026-10-08).

rows.explainer: How much more a US dollar buys in the DRC than in the US, at 2017 prices (household consumption PPP over the market exchange rate). Converts goods delivered into the same purchasing power as consumption surveys.

rows.label: Crude death rate, 2024 (deaths per person-year)

source.title: World Bank, World Development Indicators: Death rate, crude (per 1,000 people), SP.DYN.CDRT.IN (UN WPP)
source.note: Congo, Dem. Rep., 2024: 8.424 deaths per 1,000 people (WDI last updated 2026-10-08); divided by 1,000.

rows.explainer: Deaths per person a year in the whole population, the normal rate a crisis's excess mortality is measured against.
